title: Level 2 — Write a file then read it back

stages.prompt: Use wren_write_file with path='data/wren_sandbox/L2_note.md' and content='# Wren L2 Note\n- I wrote this myself\n- Next stage will read it back'. Nothing else. STAGE_OUT: <tool result verbatim>.
Use wren_read_file with path='data/wren_sandbox/L2_note.md'. STAGE_OUT: the exact content you got back, prefixed with 'read:'.
